race.comment: SURFY PETE (10) wasn't far away last time out, finishing third over 1600m at Ballarat to continue a good run of form. Slight rise in trip won't hurt and he should take beating. WEATHER DELAY (5) was safely held when 15th last time out over 1800m at Morphettville, beaten 12 lengths but was solid winning prior and can turn things around quickly. STATE OF AFFAIRS (9) got home well at Tatura when last seen to grab fourth and should be fitter second up. KILNA (2) is a six-year-old gelding who is having his first run for the Paul Preusker barn. Off a long break so watch the betting for the sharp yard.
